name: Goths
alt: Goths of Scandza and the Vistula

successors.name: Gothia
successors.text: the Goths' lands on the Vistula and Bug, then 'Scythia', 'roughly in modern Ukraine' (Oium page); Cliopatria's Gothia row opens in 207 between the Dniester and the Dnieper

ledger.x: 30: the Goths appear in Scandza, their homeland in Jordanes' account.
43: the Goths leave Scandza for the Vistula.
43: the Goths land at Gothiscandza on the Vistula mouth.
154: the coastal homeland drops out of the Gothic shape as the people move south-east.
154: the Goths move south-east towards the Black Sea.
206: the Goths pass into Gothia on the Black Sea steppe.

wars.name: Gothic conquest of Gothiscandza (Jordanes' account)
wars.outcome: In Jordanes' story the Goths chased the Rugians from the Vistula mouth and then 'defeated their new neighbours, the Vandals'; the page dates only the migration, 'the first half of the 1st century CE', and doubts Jordanes' reliability.

certainty.note: A people on the move, known from Greco-Roman ethnography and archaeological cultures; no frontier is recorded.
